PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began, without cloud recognition. Nothing you say is written to disk.

## New in this release

### Hear what PrivateType is doing

You no longer need to look at the bubble to know whether to speak or wait.

- **Ping: speak now.** The ready ping now plays every time the microphone starts listening, not only after the model had to load.
- **"Loading model."** When the model has to load first, a voice says so; the ping follows as soon as you can speak.
- **Release blip: the microphone is off.** A soft falling blip plays shortly after you release the shortcut, so it never talks over your last word.
- **"Transcribing."** After a long dictation with Parakeet, you hear "Transcribing" instead of the blip, the moment you release. Short dictations, which are inserted almost at once, stay with the blip. PrivateType predicts the wait from how long you spoke and learns your computer's speed from each dictation, in memory only.
- **Settings → Ready sound → Spoken cues** chooses a female voice (default), a male voice, or Off, with **Preview**. The volume slider controls every cue, and 0% mutes them all.
- The voices are recordings bundled with the app, generated with the open Kokoro-82M model (Apache-2.0). Nothing is synthesized or downloaded while you dictate.
- Cues now start from their first syllable: PrivateType keeps the audio output awake while you dictate, so an idle device no longer swallows the beginning of a sound.

### The bubble follows your work

- When dictation starts, the bubble moves to the monitor of the window you are dictating into, rather than the monitor under the mouse. If no window is active, it still follows the mouse.

### Settings

- Long checkbox descriptions wrap instead of running off narrow Settings pages.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.3.0-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.3.0-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.3.0` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. Choose a speech model on first launch and approve its separate download if it is not already in the shared cache.

Speech models are not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads the one you choose directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use. Models already downloaded by version 1.2.0 are reused.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
- A modern x64 CPU and at least 4 GB RAM; 8 GB or more is recommended
- About 2 GB free disk space for the portable app, model, and working room; add 0.7 GB to keep both models
- [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015–2022 (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, or retained audio. Recent dictations stay in memory only and can be turned off in Settings. The new diagnostics for spoken cues record only timings (how long you spoke and how long transcription took), never what you said. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
